messages.text: Monday, September 21 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast skies, a hint of autumn, and local learning opportunities
Today brings overcast skies with a cool autumn feel, as the season edges closer to the equinox. Local events offer chances to learn new skills or enjoy live performances.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 61°F and a low around 52°F, with a minimal chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:20 AM, sunset at 7:33 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing gibbous, 72.0% illuminated.
Learn something new or enjoy the arts

For those interested in hands-on learning, the AADL Pittsfield offers a free Beginner Needle Felting workshop at 6:00 PM. Alternatively, experience live music with Glenn Jones, Liam Grant, and Nick Schillace at Trinosophes in Detroit at 7:30 PM.
Collin's birthday is today, September 21.
Local incidents and community well-being discussions

A 19-year-old has been charged following a crash in Oak Park on September 17 that killed an Uber driver and injured a passenger. Separately, an article offers 10 ways to combat loneliness in the Ann Arbor community.
Tomorrow and the days ahead
Tomorrow, consider the immersive culinary series at Flowers of Vietnam in Detroit, or the Ann Arbor Festival of Song at Kerrytown Concert House. The September Equinox arrives the day after tomorrow.
Space navigation and cosmic history

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras. Meanwhile, Hubble telescope data has identified a major merger from the Milky Way’s infancy, suggesting an ancient collision with a dwarf galaxy.
The schedule for the next Starship launch is unset, with independent estimates listing no earlier than September 18, 2026.
A quiet day offers space for reflection and engagement.
Tuesday, September 22 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn Equinox Arrives with Overcast Skies
The Autumn Equinox arrives today under overcast skies with a high near 65°F. Local events include a robotics meeting, while a NASA satellite experiment demonstrates GPS-free navigation.
Today will be overcast with a high near 65°F and a low around 48°F.
Sunrise is at 7:21 AM and sunset is at 7:31 PM, with the moon 80.3% illuminated and waxing gibbous.
Evening Gatherings and Cultural Offerings
Consider the Lightning Robotics Parent Informational Meeting at 7:00 PM. For a cultural experience, Anishinaabe storytelling is offered at Arboretum Detroit.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is this Thursday.
Local Incidents and Community Well-being
A 19-year-old was charged in Oak Park after a crash that killed an Uber driver and injured a passenger. An article also offers 10 ways to combat loneliness in Ann Arbor.
Tomorrow and Beyond
Tomorrow features a "Community Table" event on wet felting basics in Ann Arbor or a book launch and discussion at Cranbrook Art Museum.
Satellites Navigate Without GPS

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and object catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review, targeting an August 30 launch.
The next Starship launch is estimated no earlier than September 18, 2026.
The longest night gives way to lengthening days; find your measure of light.
